description: MIP daily/qfq component of the shared lossless daily-price backup; source data, not canonical Qlib bars.
limitations: Hash identifies the complete archive shared by qfq and none; resolve does not extract or certify the component.
Coverage dates and symbol counts are aggregate, not a complete daily universe or matched qfq/none coverage.
Latest-vintage vendor prices, not certified point-in-time market information.
Volume units, amount scale, security type and adjustment consistency require validation before canonical conversion.
No historical membership, ST/suspension history, financials, factor cache or corporate-action cash ledger included.
Supplier data rights are separate from repository code licensing.
